title: Lyft Business Launch and Internal Communications
summary: Launch marketing and internal communications for Lyft Business across landing pages, email, presentations, and motion.
overview: Through Forge HQ, I supported Lyft Business across two workstreams: launch marketing for a new service, including demand-generation landing pages and email templates, and internal communications using motion and animated presentations.

projectBrief.context: Lyft Business needed additional creative support for a new service launch while its internal team managed other priorities.
projectBrief.challenge: Launch assets had to move forward on schedule alongside a separate stream of internal communications work.
projectBrief.contribution: Through Forge HQ, I designed demand-generation landing pages, email templates, a webinar thank-you page, motion, and animated presentation work.
projectBrief.approach: I organized the work into reusable launch and communications formats that could be reviewed and delivered alongside the internal team's existing workload.
projectBrief.outcome: The added support helped Lyft Business keep the launch work on schedule without pulling its internal creative team away from other priorities.
